We are pushing forward into Day 7 of the massive Amazon Black Friday sale with AirPods Pro 3 live at an insane $100 off the list price, the $300 price drops on M5 MacBook Air, MacBook Neo from $649, and Apple Watch Series 12 at $100 off. But today we also spotted even lower prices and new all-time lows on Apple’s brand new touchscreen PROLED XDR MacBook Pro at up to $290 off (some of the higher-end models are catching even deeper deals too).

You might want to jump on the new OLED iPad mini while it’s $100 off (it is already starting to sell out), the new Apple Watch Ultra 4 with the all-new Translucent Ocean Band Gray Ocean Band is back at its lowest price ever, we have new all-time lows on the 2026 Apple Wrist Strap from $21, the official ecobee Black Friday HomeKit sale at up to $130 off, and much more down below.

Amazon 2026 Black Friday Week – Day 7: AirPods Pro 3 $100 off, Google Pixel even lower, 50% off premium brands, more

The Best Black Friday deal is already live: AirPods Pro 3 at $100 off (Same price as entry-level AirPods)

Okay folks we are back with the latest AirPods Pro 3 live again at a wild $100 off the list price! There’s no telling how long this incredible deal will last, as it went out of stock quite quickly yesterday, but it is now live again…get in there quick.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $149 (Reg. $249) – $100 off, All-time low

After dropping to $179 to start the Black Friday bonanza, the price plummeted again at $100 off to deliver the very best deal we have tracked.

The deals land just after the wild $100 price drop on AirPods Pro 3, the ongoing $100 price drops on Apple Watch Series 12, the new all-time low on a AirTag 2 at just $18 Prime shipped, and the $300 price drop on M5 MacBook Air.

Amazon delivered the first notable price drops on Apple’s 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display to launch its Black Friday sale this year, but it has now dropped the price on various configurations even lower to between $199 and $290 off:

  • 16-inch PROLED XDR MacBook Pro with touch 24GB/1TB $3,200 (Reg. $3,399)

OLED iPad mini Black Friday deal already selling out, score one now at $100 off while you still can

The Day 7 Amazon Black Friday offers are very much ushering loads of new discounts, not mention carrying the wild $100 price drop on AirPods Pro 3, but we wanted to touchdown to talk mini, iPad mini. The new OLED model has dropped to all-time low pricing at $100 off, but it is already starting to sell out.

Amazon is now offering the new iPad mini (A20 Pro) with the OLED display at $599 shipped.

  • NEW OLED iPad mini (A20 Pro) $599 (Reg. $699) – All-time low

That’s $100 off the $699 list price and a particularly notable discount for a brand new iPad that just landed this month.

The thing is, it is already starting to sell out as of this morning. While the Midnight model is still live at $100 off, the Starlight colorway has completely disappeared. Will the iPad mini come back in stock for Black Friday? Yes, maybe, but we can’t say for sure and with so many amazing Apple deals already going live ahead of Black Friday proper later this week, there’s really no way to know for sure if it will, or if it will return at the heavily discounted rate. You might want to get in there while you can.

iVANKY 26-in-1 Thunderbolt 5 FusionDock Ultra now $150 off for Black Friday

iVANKY’s Thunderbolt 5 FusionDock Ultra has dropped to its very best price of the year at $599.99 exclusively via the brand’s official site and over on Amazon using code 9TO5MAC for Black Friday 2026 (also available on Amazon UK at £599.99 with no coded needed). That’s $150 off and $50 under the next best price of 2026. If you’re looking to setup a powerful workstation or upgrade your existing rig, the 26-port FusionDock Ultra is specifically designed to elevate demanding Apple Silicon Mac workstations with support for up to four native 6K displays, 140W charging, 10Gb Ethernet, and a combination of dual-chip architecture and active cooling for stable, dependable performance – scope out our hands-on review for a closer look. If the FusionDock Ultra is a bit overkill for you, the FusionDock Max 2 is a more affordable alternative that still delivers the Thunderbolt 5 and multi-display connectivity you need for a capable Mac workstation – it’s now down at $359.99 from the regular $449.99 for Black Friday.

  • iVANKY FusionDock Ultra $600 ($150 off)

Apple Watch Ultra 4 with all-new Translucent Ocean Band nearly $100 off for Black Friday

As we push into day 7 of the giant Amazon Black Friday sale, Apple’s AirPods 3 are now sitting at a crazy $100 off the list price and, quite possibly one of the hottest pickups of the season is now also at all-time lows – the latest Apple Watch releases. The Series 12 models are now $100 off and you’ll find Apple’s top end Ultra 4 model with the all-new Translucent Ocean Band back at its best price as well.

While we are still waiting (hoping) on a deal of the Black Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 4 with the Translucent Black Ocean Band, I happen to be a more of fan of the Natural Titanium case options and the latest model with the sweet whitish-gray Translucent Ocean Band is back at its all-time low – the Natural color just seems to work better with any outfit in my opinion, but the Black is super nice too.

Amazon is now offering the Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 4 with the all-new Translucent Ocean Band Gray Ocean Band at $699.99 shipped.

Regularly $799, this is just shy of $100 off the list price and on par with the lowest price we have tracked since release in September. If history is any indication (the way deals went on Ultra 3 last Black Friday), there is a strong chance the price will max out at $699 for this year’s event.
